submittedParameters.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. ONE independent native HD>=1024 square RGBA transparent game-animation frame. Image1 is the edit target: retain exact head/hair, torso, both arms sleeves hands weapons and canvas scale/position. Redraw ONLY legs and adjoining skirt fabric. Image2 is same-character leg anatomy reference. Image3 is approved grounding anatomy only, never copy its identity, bow, clothes. Image4 identity; image5 approved painted style. DIRECTION N pure rear view running away. Anatomical RIGHT hand sword must remain on screen-right, LEFT hand blue rectangular talisman on screen-left. Exactly two connected legs, short original limb proportions. Frame15 of16: LEFT screen-left foot is the ONLY support at BACK push-off position, fourth spatial pair A. Replace old right support legs entirely with image2 LEFT-support ownership. LEFT thigh extends rearward toward viewer, knee soft, forefoot presses ground near95%canvas, heel starts lifting but ball/toe still firmly loaded. RIGHT knee advances forward/deeper, right shoe airborne and partly foreshortened by skirt; not planted. Same support foot must stay loaded on the world ground for 8 frames, with four progressive fore-aft ground positions, two independent poses per position. In rear view ground depth changes projected shoe height; never force all shoe-bottoms to a horizontal line. Keep feet axes straight NORTH, no outward toe yaw. Natural bent knees and meaningful weight; no standing mannequin, no extra limbs, no whole-character translation or scale change. Never move head or arms to compensate. Genuine transparent alpha; no shadow, guide, text, contact line or background.
